# fossa_oidc_provider (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `issuer` (String) The issuer URL of the OIDC Provider
- `scope` (String) The scope level of the OIDC Provider

### Optional

- `scope_id` (Number) The ID of the team

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the OIDC Provider was created
- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the OIDC Provider
- `organization_id` (Number) The ID of the organization this provider belongs to
- `updated_at` (String) When the OIDC Provider was last updated
